findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: speech_to_text, web_page_to_markdown · Private data: token_safety_check, speech_to_text, image_to_text_ocr, erc20_token_quick_scan, crypto_address_validate, create_crypto_payment_request, wallet_balances_multichain, domain_email_security_audit, token_safety_check_demo · Public sink: domain_email_security_audit · Destructive: token_safety_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: speech_to_text, web_page_to_markdown · Private data: token_safety_check, speech_to_text, image_to_text_ocr, erc20_token_quick_scan, crypto_address_validate, create_crypto_payment_request, wallet_balances_multichain, domain_email_security_audit, token_safety_check_demo · Public sink: domain_email_security_audit · Destructive: token_safety_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
